brief.headline: Move from 100% advance to 30-day terms — that alone frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we already pay Sayaji Industries for the same Dextrose
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹70.80/KG — that's 6.5% more than our best price for identical material from Sayaji. The open-market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose sits in ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so our target of ₹66.48/KG sits comfortably inside the normal band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Stop paying 100% advance; move to standard 30 days after delivery
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash immediately; if they agree to just 15 extra days that's still ₹4.36 L back in our pocket

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financial statements, so we can't see their books. That means we lean on what we know: our ₹1.06 Cr annual spend, the fact that we pay them 100% upfront (the worst terms in our book), and the six credible backup producers we've identified. Paying in advance hands them all the power and ties up nearly ₹9 lakh of our money — money we should be using elsewhere. With multiple proven alternates available and no way to judge their true financial position, our leverage comes from being ready to walk if they won't meet the market and normalize terms.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹1.06 Cr a year
Our price is 6.5% above the best price we already pay elsewhere
That gap costs us ₹12.95 L every year
We pay 100% in advance — the single worst payment term we have with any supplier
Moving to 30-day credit unlocks ₹8.73 L of cash for us
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP runs ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target of ₹66.48/KG is smack in the middle

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited
alternates.why: Already supplying us Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG — our benchmark price and a proven, qualified source

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller making Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, established in dextrose/sorbitol — a drop-in alternate to our current suppliers; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

risks: No public financials means we can't see if they're stable or struggling — so don't squeeze so hard that a hidden weak supplier collapses mid-contract
Paying 100% advance gives them zero incentive to negotiate — they already have our cash; be ready to place a trial order with an alternate to show we're serious
Six backup producers exist, but only Sayaji is qualified today — start the CoA review process with Tirupati or Gulshan now so we have a live second source in 60–90 days
If they refuse both asks (price and terms), our fallback is to shift the full ₹1.06 Cr volume to Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG and recover the ₹12.95 L saving immediately
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to keep working together, but right now we're paying you ₹70.80/KG and 100% in advance — while we pay Sayaji ₹66.48/KG on credit for the same material; help us close that gap so we can grow the business with you.
